invariant: PlantUML paints SVEK leaves in GraphvizImageBuilder construction order, which is namespace traversal order rather than one global constructor-ID order. buildImage calls printGroups before getUnpackagedEntities. For each nonempty group, printGroup creates that group's direct leaves in quark creation order, adds each resulting SvekNode to that group's Cluster, then recurses through child groups in group creation order. Empty package groups enter that child-group traversal as leaf nodes. Only after every root group is complete are unpackaged root leaves created. CommandFactoryNoteOnEntity creates attached notes as real NOTE leaves through quarkInContext in the parser's current namespace; floating named notes use the same quark ownership. A note owned by a reopened outer package therefore remains a direct leaf of that outer package even when it targets an entity in a nested child package. Cluster membership constrains the note in the owning package's layout solve, and the SVG data-qualified-name is the owning quark path plus the generated GMN or explicit note alias. Bibliotekon and SvekResult preserve this construction stream and ownership through painting.
causal_divergence: The aa9c4cfa implementation now records owner_package and places notes correctly in the package-first/root-last emission stream, fixing the original global paint-order inversion. It does not carry that ownership through the rest of the model. render_with_oracle_uid_origin adds ordinary entity nodes and empty-package leaf nodes to package clusters, but never adds attached_note_layout_id or floating_note_layout_id nodes. Package-owned notes are consequently solved as root nodes even though their traversal position is package-local. Reconstructing cluster membership in separate entity, note, and empty-package batches would also discard the quark creation order already represented by svek_node_emission_order. render_svek_note_emission emits attached notes with a bare GMN qualified name and floating notes with a bare alias, discarding the same owner path. Left and right attached-note connectors are Java length-one links: Bibliotekon stores them in lines0, DotStringFactory serializes them before ordinary nodes, and SvekEdge uses minlen zero. Rust currently adds every attached-note connector as an ordinary late edge with no explicit minlen. After layout, Java EntityImageNote reverses the routed path when necessary so its start is nearest the note, then getOpaleStrategy chooses the callout side by orthogonal distance from that contact to the note's four side lines, with left, right, up, down tie priority. Rust instead selects the callout side from the original note position syntax and uses a synthetic side midpoint. Package constraints can place a note on the opposite side from that syntax even when layout coordinates otherwise match exactly. Fresh reopened-package counterexamples therefore move or reorder notes outside the Java cluster solve, serialize the wrong identity, route horizontal callouts from a different graph-construction stream, and paint the fold from the wrong solved side, while a root-owned control passes.
planned_change: Use the existing note_owner_packages projection as the single ownership source after note nodes are created. Populate rendered package clusters from the unified svek_node_emission_order stream so entities, attached notes, floating notes, and empty-package leaves retain Java quark creation order instead of being batched by kind. For every SVEK note leaf with an owning rendered package cluster, add its attached or floating layout node id to that cluster exactly as GraphvizImageBuilder#printGroup adds the note's SvekNode; do not infer ownership from the note target. Carry the same owner package path into note painting and qualify generated GMN and explicit aliases with the package name using the existing namespace identity rules. Root-owned notes remain unqualified. Register left and right attached-note connectors as PlantUML SVEK lines0 with minlen zero, preserving their actual endpoint direction; top and bottom connectors remain length-two ordinary edges. During attached-note paint, retain both routed endpoints, identify the endpoint on the note side from the known link direction, and reproduce EntityImageNote#getOpaleStrategy from that solved contact instead of the declaration syntax; use the same contact for the callout base and the opposite endpoint for its tip. Preserve the cpt1 UID allocation, and introduce no geometry constants, dimension changes, or post-hoc SVG movement.
